expectations.text: identifies-body-context-loss: body-append drops vars/theme classes/container ancestry
expectations.evidence: Sections 1-2 cover lost container queries and inherited custom properties; compact density driven by variable overrides.

expectations.text: explains-container-query-break: container queries resolve against absent/wrong container off-body
expectations.evidence: Section 1 explains @container resolves against nearest container ancestor, none under body -> default branch, shorter box.

expectations.text: recommends-in-place-or-subtree: measure in place / probe inside real subtree / reproduce container+width
expectations.evidence: Strategy A reproduces container chain (mount inside theme root); Strategy B measures real rows on mount + cache.

expectations.text: fixes-inline-size: measure at real inline size (height is function of width)
expectations.evidence: Section 3 'Width is unconstrained'; setWidth pins container to real content width.

expectations.text: warns-copy-computed: dont snapshot getComputedStyle; replicate ancestors
expectations.evidence: Advocates replicating ancestors (clone container chain, carry classes/data-* attrs) rather than snapshotting styles; does not use getComputedStyle copy. (Weaker: never explicitly names the getComputedStyle-freeze pitfall.)
